name: agents
description: Autonomous CLI agents and missions: spawns coding agents in tmux (or on embedded Elowen AI models), watches their progress, and runs the autopilot that plans, reviews and steers multi-task missions. Extracted from the Elowen core onto the plugin platform; disabling it turns off agent spawning and missions while chat, tasks and projects keep working.

configSchema.label: Overseer
configSchema.hint: Decision model for the autopilot overseer.

configSchema.label: Overseer model
configSchema.hint: Relay model for overseer decisions; empty falls back to the planner model.

configSchema.label: PR-native missions
configSchema.hint: Branch, auto-open and verify gate for mission pull requests.

configSchema.label: PR base branch
configSchema.hint: Base branch mission PRs target; empty auto-detects per repository.

configSchema.label: Open PR automatically
configSchema.hint: Open a mission's PR as soon as its epic completes.

configSchema.label: PR verify command
configSchema.hint: Command that must exit 0 in the worktree before any PR opens; empty disables the gate.

strings.autopilotHint: Set planning, oversight and the defaults used for new mission runs.
strings.backendModeHint: Pick one mode — either via an API key, or via local CLI tools.
strings.apProviderHint: Pick a brain provider to reuse its endpoint + key, so a key is never entered twice. Pick none to enter an endpoint + key below.
strings.apNoProviders: No brain provider has a key set — enter an endpoint + key below.
strings.plannerModelHint: LLM that decomposes a goal into phases
strings.overseerExecHint: LLM that judges agent prompts (blank = same as planner)
strings.reviewOnDoneHint: After a phase closes, the overseer judges the result; if it rejects, the next phase is blocked.
strings.tddModeHint: When on, autopilot workers must write a failing test first, then implement, then verify (test-driven development).
strings.apiKeyHint: A key is set — leave blank to keep
strings.cliAgentsHint: Configure installed CLI agents, their launch arguments and workflow skills.
strings.agentSkillsHint: The "elowen-workflow" skill teaches spawned agents how to work inside Elowen. The daemon installs it on startup; here you can re-apply it manually and verify the status per provider.
strings.skipPermissionsHint: The agent runs without interactive permission prompts — otherwise waiting in tmux would stall it. Autonomy is enforced by the overseer.
strings.skipPermissionsNoop: Elowen cannot toggle this agent’s permissions from here — it either runs its built-in tools without confirmation, or you set auto-approval in the agent’s own config.
strings.resumeSessionsHint: On a restart the agent resumes its previous CLI session and keeps full context. Falls back to a fresh start otherwise.
strings.embeddedProviderHint: Runs inside the Elowen daemon — no binary or flags to configure. Workers on Elowen AI models execute in-process and close their tasks themselves.
